metric_definitions.node_id_validity: 1 iff every id in answer_node_ids exists in nodes.json; None when answer cites no node ids.
metric_definitions.cited_in_retrieved_rate: |answer_ids ∩ retrieved_ids| / |answer_ids|; None when answer cites no node ids.
metric_definitions.keyword_coverage: fraction of expected_keywords found as case-insensitive substrings in final_answer.
metric_definitions.forbidden_violation: 1 iff ANY forbidden keyword appears (lowercased substring) in final_answer; None when forbidden_keywords is empty.
metric_definitions.refusal_for_t5: 1 iff final_answer contains any of: 不包含, 没有, 无法, 未提及, 未涉及, 无关, 无相关, 不相关, not contain, no information, unable (fallback marker: '无'). Computed only for T5; None otherwise.

_meta.aggregation: Macro average per category across questions where each metric is defined. None values are skipped.
